partagas-cuba--serie.description: The Serie cigars of Partagás, the Havana house tied to the factory Don Jaime Partagás opened in 1845, made from Vuelta Abajo leaf and classed as strong by Habanos S.A. Serie bands first ran from the 1930s to the 1960s and returned in 1975 with the Serie D No. 4 robusto; the P No. 2, E No. 2, D No. 5 and D No. 6 followed between 2005 and 2014.

sources.title: Cigar Inspector – Partagás Serie D No. 4 review
Online Cigars – Partagás Serie D No. 4 review
Havana House – Partagás Serie D No. 4 review

thirds.notes: Earthy and nutty from the first draws, with cedar, a creamy feel and a spicy edge that soon settles.
The most layered stage: earth and leather with creamy cocoa, gentle spice and a floral note on the retrohale.
Dark coffee and bittersweet cocoa close the smoke, with cedar, pepper and a stronger floral tone.

partagas-cuba--clasicos.description: The traditional Partagás sizes from Havana, made with Vuelta Abajo tobacco and classed as strong by Habanos S.A., with the intense, readily recognised character of the house. Most of them, among them the Aristocrats, Habaneros, Mille Fleurs and Presidentes, date from 1960; the 8-9-8 followed in 1970, beside the long-standing Lusitanias.

thirds.notes: A measured start of cedar, wood and nuts, with sweet pepper and earth emerging after the first inch.
Deeper earth and warm spice take hold, with cocoa, leather and a floral, creamy undertone.
Spice and black pepper rise over earth, softened by cream and a honeyed sweetness as the strength builds.

partagas-cuba--linea-maduro.description: Three Partagás cigars rolled with leaf given an extra fermentation for a darker, maduro-style wrapper over the house's Vuelta Abajo blend. Maduro No. 1 first appeared in 2015 for La Casa del Habano shops; No. 2 and No. 3 joined in 2018, when the No. 1 also moved into general production.

sources.title: Cigars Lover – Partagás Maduro No. 1 review
Tiny Tim blog – Partagás Maduro No. 1 review

thirds.notes: Chocolate and black coffee lead from the start, with cedar, a hint of citrus and a peppery bite.
Cocoa and coffee stay central, now with old wood, earth and rounder spice.
Citrus drops away; cedar grows firmer beside cocoa and coffee for a balanced, spicy close.

partagas-cuba--linea-maestra.description: The most premium Partagás line, presented by Habanos S.A. at the close of the 2023 Habano Festival and in shops from 2024, in three vitolas: Origen, Rito and Maestro. It is the first line in the Habanos portfolio made entirely with tobacco from San Luis, in Vuelta Abajo, and keeps the depth of a house that Habanos classes as strong.

sources.title: Habanos S.A. – Launch of Partagás Línea Maestra
Cigars Lover – Partagás Línea Maestra Maestro review
Cigars Lover – Partagás Línea Maestra Origen review

thirds.notes: Hazelnut, dry wood and leather open the smoke, with a milky coffee note and a flick of cayenne or cinnamon.
The smoke turns creamier and leather settles in, while the overall intensity eases.
Pepper picks up and espresso can appear; the Origen grows to medium-full, the Maestro stays medium.

partagas-cuba--stopgezette-vitola-s.description: Partagás sizes that are no longer made, most of them withdrawn between the 1970s and 2010. They include the three Serie du Connaisseur cigars, dropped in 2010, the Partagás de Partagás No. 1, dropped in 2006, and older sizes such as the Lonsdales, Coronas, Chicos, Princess and Churchill de Luxe.

partagas-cuba--edicion-limitada.description: The limited editions of Partagás, each a size outside the regular range with its own Edición Limitada band. They run from the Pirámides of 2000 through several Serie D cigars and the Serie C No. 3 of 2012 to the Selección Privada of 2014, the Noblezas of 2017, which brought that size name into the Habanos range, and the Legados of 2020.

partagas-cuba--reserva-en-gran-reserva.description: Aged Partagás releases built from a single harvest. The Serie D No. 4 Reserva of 2005 used leaf from the 2000 crop, rested for three years; the Lusitanias Gran Reserva of 2013, from the 2007 harvest, was the brand's first Gran Reserva, and a Serie E No. 2 Gran Reserva from the 2015 crop followed in 2021.

partagas-cuba--coleccion-habanos-en-spec.description: Partagás cigars made for one-off programmes outside the regular range: Colección Habanos sizes such as the Serie C No. 1 of 2002 and the Serie E No. 1 of 2013, the Coronas Gordas Añejados of 2015, aged five to eight years before release, and the Tropicales humidor for the brand's 175th anniversary, limited to 450 numbered humidors of 50 cigars.
